from pathlib import Path
import csv,io,json,subprocess,sys
d=Path('products/services/catalogue-qa/integrated-delivery');d.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
base=Path('products/services/catalogue-qa/fulfillment')
for src,out in [('synthetic-v.csv','variants.csv'),('synthetic-i.csv','images.csv')]: (d/out).write_bytes((base/src).read_bytes())
def run(args):
 r=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True);return {'argv':args,'exit':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr}
site='products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example/'
v=str(d/'variants.csv');im=str(d/'images.csv');out=str(d/'ours.csv')
records=list(csv.DictReader(open(v,newline='')));assert len(records)<=20
execution=[run([sys.executable,site+'transform.py','--variants',v,'--images',im,'--out',out,'--report',str(d/'transform-report.json')])]
assert execution[-1]['exit']==0,execution
execution.append(run([sys.executable,site+'verify_example.py',v,im,out]))
assert execution[-1]['exit']==0,execution[-1]
with open(out,newline='') as f:
 reader=csv.DictReader(f);headers=reader.fieldnames;rows=list(reader)
eligible=[i for i,r in enumerate(rows) if r['SKU']]
assert len(eligible)>=2
first,second=eligible[:2];original=rows[first]['Barcodes'];rows[first]['Barcodes']='999999999999'
rows.append(dict(rows[second]))
produced=d/'provided.csv'
with produced.open('w',newline='') as f:
 w=csv.DictWriter(f,headers,lineterminator='\n');w.writeheader();w.writerows(rows)
execution.append(run([sys.executable,site+'verify_example.py',v,im,str(produced)]))
assert execution[-1]['exit']==1
execution.append(run([sys.executable,'products/services/catalogue-qa/preservation-findings/locate_preservation.py',v,str(produced)]))
assert execution[-1]['exit']==1
findings=json.loads(execution[-1]['stdout'])['findings']
assert any(x['kind']=='value_difference' and x['field']=='Barcodes' for x in findings)
assert any(x['kind']=='ambiguous_duplicate_key' for x in findings)
over=records+[dict(records[0]) for _ in range(21-len(records))]
assert len(over)==21
with (d/'overlimit.csv').open('w',newline='') as f:
 w=csv.DictWriter(f,list(over[0]),lineterminator='\n');w.writeheader();w.writerows(over)
count=sum(1 for _ in csv.DictReader((d/'overlimit.csv').open(newline='')))
intake={'variant_csv_records':count,'decision':'REJECT_BEFORE_TRANSFORM','transform_invoked':False,'method':'csv.DictReader data-record count; header excluded'}
assert count>20
reply='Autonomous AI agents / Agents d’IA autonomes. Synthetic demonstration only / Démonstration synthétique uniquement.\n'
reply+='Original generated output passed the existing verifier. The deliberately modified supplied output failed; exact localization follows. / La sortie initiale passe le vérificateur; la sortie modifiée échoue. Localisation exacte ci-dessous.\n'
reply+=json.dumps(findings,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
reply+='\nDuplicate SKU records remain ambiguous; no arbitrary pairing. Record numbers exclude the header; physical_lines reports file lines. / SKU dupliqués ambigus, sans appariement arbitraire. Les numéros d’enregistrement excluent l’en-tête; physical_lines indique les lignes physiques.\n'
reply+='21 variant records are refused before transformation. / 21 enregistrements de variantes sont refusés avant transformation.\nNo actual recipient delivery, Shopify import, image retrieval or store access was tested. / Aucun envoi réel, import Shopify, téléchargement d’image ou accès boutique testé.\n'
(d/'reply-en-fr.txt').write_text(reply)
result={'label':'SYNTHETIC ONLY; no customer or revenue','eligible_records':len(records),'execution':execution,'overlimit':intake,'private_selection':'Not established here; builder must verify available frozen service paths against AGENTMAIL before closure.'}
(d/'execution.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print(json.dumps({'execution_exits':[x['exit'] for x in execution],'findings':findings,'overlimit':intake}))
